title: A worker's edit to a file outside its own worktree is refused before it lands
goal: a headless worker's Edit or Write to a path outside its worktree and scratch directory (the orchestrator's tree above it) is refused by a hook naming its worktree

run: import json,sys; s=json.dumps(json.load(open(".claude/settings.json",encoding="utf-8")).get("hooks",{})); ok="worktree" in s.lower(); print("a hook guards worker writes outside the worktree:",ok); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: SP-jplczvj2 close: ST-corcepuz's worker made two edits to the orchestrator's _tools/ql_learn.py by a wrong path and restored them itself; nothing refused the write. The check is a first cut: the planner replaces it with a run of the hook on a planted path.
